SYMPTOM: 30s watchdog sets errorMessage + uiState='error'. Backend then succeeds and emits transcription_ready. Output displayed but errorMessage persists — user sees both success content AND error banner.

CAUSE: transcription_ready handler only set output, never cleared errorMessage.

FIX: Added errorMessage: undefined (or null) clear in transcription_ready handler in event-listeners.ts. Also clear watchdog state (lastHeartbeatTime reset).

PREVENT: Any handler that represents 'transcription succeeded' must clear error state. Same principle applies to no_speech_detected — it IS a terminal state, clear watchdog explicitly (don't rely on 10s self-heal).
